name: NUO OS v1.4.6
notes: New: a global AI floating window — click the sparkle bubble in the bottom-right corner on any page to chat, drag the panel anywhere, and it remembers its position. It reuses the built-in free AI channel (no API key needed). Both the AI page and floating window now support exporting the conversation to a Markdown (.md) file. New: in Vocaloid (术力口) mode the floating ball becomes Miku, Teto or Rei with three chibi pictures rotating, a small button / right-click switches to the next character, and the ball pops up playful lines; the AI also replies in that character's tone. Changed: the character no longer walks over the interface; selecting a character only switches the background theme using each character's original official illustration.
